_note: Default fit per garment type for the avatar pack (MVP-03). Every garment size is derived from the wearer's own tape measurements plus the ease and proportions below, so no real-item flat measurements are needed. Changing a value is a reviewed edit: rebuild and run the checks. All lengths in cm unless a name says 'fraction'.
_colour_note: Neutral light grey, sRGB 0-255. The app sets the colour (MVP-06); a light base multiplies cleanly if the app tints the material instead of replacing it.

tee._necklines_note: Other necklines (V1.1-04), the same shell cut differently. Depths decided by Joe on 15 Nov 2026: V 12 cm and scoop 9 cm below the shoulder-top line, against the crew neck's 6 cm. width_factor scales the crew neck's width.

sweatshirt._note: Regular-fit crew-neck sweatshirt (MVP-07), an alternative top over the trousers. More chest ease than the tee, long sleeves, hem and cuffs drawn in as ribbing would (hem gap measured from the trousers, cuff gap from the wrist). The hem and cuffs are placed by the body (hem above the crotch, cuff short of the wrist joint) rather than by a length, so they sit the same way on every body.

trousers._note: Regular-fit straight trousers, hem just above the floor.
